Job Title: Site Reliability Engineer
Experience: 3-6 years
Location: India

Mandatory Skills:
- Kubernetes
- Docker

Good to have:
- Linux
- Helm
- Terraform
- Prometheus

Responsibilities:
- Join a fast-growing cloud infrastructure team at a mid-stage SaaS company that delivers real-time analytics to enterprise customers. Own the reliability, scalability and performance of containerized production services.
- Design, build and operate Kubernetes-based clusters and deployment pipelines using Docker images. Implement best practices for cluster autoscaling, networking, security and multi-tenant isolation.
- Collaborate with development teams to containerize applications, optimize resource usage, and troubleshoot runtime issues in staging and production environments.
- Create, maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines to automate build, test and deployment workflows for microservices delivered as Docker containers.
- Implement monitoring, alerting and incident response playbooks; tune service-level objectives (SLOs) and service-level indicators (SLIs) to meet uptime targets.
- Drive infrastructure as code initiatives for provisioning and management of cloud resources; integrate with observability and logging solutions.
- Perform root cause analysis for incidents, implement fixes and preventative measures, and document runbooks to reduce mean time to recovery.
- Mentor junior engineers, perform on-call rotations, and participate in capacity planning and disaster recovery exercises.
